blocks.heading: Freestyle.
blocks.lead: Placed where the fade is shortest.
paragraphs: The designs on this page are freestyle lines and curves. Look at where they sit: right where the fade goes short, above and behind the ear, so the shape shows up clean against the skin.
The first one sweeps above the ear on a skin fade under a short top. The second curves behind the ear on a low fade, with texture left on top.
None of the four on this page are the same. You can bring a picture of a design you like, or tell me roughly where you want it and how bold, and we'll go from there.

blocks.heading: Kids too.
blocks.lead: Two of these are on kids.
paragraphs: A design is a simple way for a kid to make a plain fade their own. The two below sit on short fades with a little length left on top. One is a freestyle curve running from the temple to behind the ear. The other is a set of lines cut above the ear.

alt.design-kids-fade-freestyle: Boy's fade with a freestyle curved design from the temple to behind the ear
alt.design-kids-fade-lines: Boy's fade with lines cut above the ear and a textured top

blocks.heading: Getting one.
paragraphs: Hair design sits on my add-on list on Booksy. If you're not sure how to pair it with the cut you want, text me and ask before booking. Texting is the quickest way to reach me.
Going all in? The Luxury Grooming Experience already includes a basic hair design, along with the beard sculpt, steam, hot towels and the rest.

Because a design sits in the shortest part of the fade, it softens as that hair grows back in. Every visit is by appointment, and you pay once it's done. Cash and card both work, and so do Zelle and Cash App.

items.q: How much does a hair design cost?
items.a: The hair design add-on is {{addon:hair-design}} on Booksy.

items.q: Can kids get a hair design?
items.a: Yes, kids are welcome. Two of the designs on this page were cut on young clients.

items.q: Is a design included in any service?
items.a: Yes. The Luxury Grooming Experience, at {{price:luxury-grooming}}, comes with a basic hair design along with the rest of the service.
